title: Tue 06 Oct 2026: Nasdaq record as gilt yields near six percent, BoE November hike signals, AIFM consultation closes 14 Oct
summary: Nvidia leads the Nasdaq to a record while Treasury and gilt yields sit near multi-decade highs and oil trades on Hormuz headlines. The Bank of England edges towards a November rate rise; regulation covers the FCA's Annual Public Meeting, the confirmed 14 October close of the alternative fund managers consultation and the crypto gateway dates; plus three COO action points and the week's diary.
